It shows the last run, the actions it took with a reason for each, a rolling list of recent actions, deferred candidates, and anything that needs a human. The routine writes it to the `janitor/ledger` branch, and a workflow on that branch applies it here.

## Last run

## This run
- **Issues closed:** none. origin/main is still `045d7ec7` and no PR has merged since #581 (2026-10-02 19:59Z), so no issue has a new fix to verify. The 12 open issues that merged PRs mention (#267, #325, #362, #424, #437, #439, #466, #473, #489, #504, #561, #571) are all cited as "related" or "not fixed here", never as closed by the PR. The ~70 new issues (#697–#783) are not duplicates. Spot checks on origin/main match their claims: #781 (`parse_go_mod_module` is called only from tests), #744 (only `embed_vex_into_json` and the vendor arm emit the `dry_run` marker), and #273 (`insert_maven_repository` and `repository_block` still emit bare `\n`). Close calls: #742/#765/#769/#720/#650 (superseding patch never picked up) are the same symptom in different PMs with different code paths. #747 is a sub-item of tracking issue #748, and #716/#717 are sub-items of #715. #779 is a bug and #780 is the refactor that would fix it. #713 and #714 (Rush) have different triggers.
- **Labels fixed:** none needed. Every bughunt issue has a `pm:*` label, and no closed issue carries `agent:claimed`. #778–#783 are still waiting for triage, which the janitor leaves to the triage agent.
- **Claims released:** none. All 72 claims map to an open PR, and none has passed 48h without one. The Gradle batch (Claim-ID `2026-10-02T13:56:32Z-gradle21`) maps to open PR #646.
- **Discussion ops:** none apart from this log. No ledger has new drift. #307 (#579) and #308 (#434) still carry drift that was already reported. #312 still lists closed #332, #451 and #502 as `fail`, already reported on 2026-10-02. #575 has been corrected (it now marks #579 closed). No ledger cites an issue number that doesn't exist, and no PM has two ledgers.
